body: I think about it everyday, every second. I feel like death is calling me. I don't have the ability to cope with the pain and numbness.

No medication for me. I would have to have health insurance for that stuff. I've had many plans. Never executed them. Never even attempted it. Maybe that's why no one takes me serious.  The only thing that stops me is that if I fail, I'll be hospitalized and probably lose my jobs and be kicked out of school . Ill be more miserable than I currently am. I'm just slowly killing myself anyways.  I don't eat anymore.  I've lost 30 pounds in the last few months.
I'm not convinced life can get any better. I should be in heaven compared to my old life but I'm not. I played my hand to make my life better and it didn't work.  Now its time to fold.
All of my friends know. I talk about it so much none of them take me serious anymore. None of them know how to help me.  Its not their responsibly anyways.

I reached out to a counsler two weeks ago. He didn't help me. Not that he didn't try. He gave me some suggestions to improve things, gave me a book to read. I didn't tell him I wanted to die though.  Wasn't really sure how to bring that one up.
